notes.title: Update notes for May 31st 2024
notes.content:
•	Fixed some bugs in the tab menu showing bad ping incorrectly.
•	Improvements for hit-reg.
•	Added “mascot horde” halftime mode.
•	Fix crash on slingshot.
•	Homebase Runway Material update.
•	You should now always be able to tell where someone is looking while parachuting.
•	Slight adjustment to the solo capture time. 
•	Adjusted end of match timer. 
•	Updated landmine throwing animation.
•	Fixed “Like” emote to work while downed. 
•	Sliding animation update.
•	Intro Cinematics have new animations.
•	The respawn beacon now has 40% less health, a sniper shot or a melee hit will now destroy it in a single attack.
•	Updated respawn beacon’s spawn facing. 
•	Addressed a number of collision issues. 
•	All weapons should have proper moving parts (bolts/slides) when shooting. 
•	New pistol animation set.
•	Full auto firing animations should match the fire rate of the weapon used.
•	Fixed jitter when swapping from Assault Rifle <-> flump

notes.title: Global 36 hour Playtest Starting May 31st!
notes.content:
[h3][b]The Schedule[/b][/h3]
The test kicks off on May 31, 2024 7:00 PM UTC for all servers globally and is scheduled to end at 3:00 AM UTC on June 2nd.

[h3][b]What are we testing?[/b][/h3]
We have three areas we are focused on for this weekend’s playtest:

[b]Latency:[/b] Last time we had some issues with players not getting paired up on their closest servers. We’re going to be trying out a solution this weekend.

[b]Hit-reg:[/b] Last playtest you told us that there were some major hit-reg issues. We are tweaking a few things that should help improve your experience here.

[b]Who needs their fix:[/b] We’ve had thousands of you requesting access to our next Alpha playtest after our last test on the 19th, and folks on our Discord have been asking about the next test daily. One goal this weekend is to see how many folks actually show up with their friends to play some Combat Champions!

[h3][b]How are we granting access?[/b][/h3]
A few hours before a server goes live, everyone who has requested access to our playtest on Steam will be allowed in to start downloading the game.
Once the playtest begins, we’ll open up the playtest so all your buddies can roll in, request access, and hop right into the action.

[h3][b]Important notes![/b][/h3]
We will be seeking specific feedback you can send us via the in-game feedback button, but to join the ongoing conversation please join our Discord server here: https://discord.gg/hpWNUyNNkM 

C77 Entertainment
